# Reflection Log

<!-- Each entry is appended after meaningful work completes.
     Entries capture what was surprising, what future agents should know,
  and what should be proposed for local harness guidance or human review.

  Do NOT treat AGENTS.md as an editable target from this log. Use this log
  to capture raw learnings, then let humans decide whether anything should
  become local HARNESS.md guidance or broader company-wide guidance.
  The value of this log is that it preserves raw
     learnings for later curation and harness improvements.

     Entry format:

     ---

     - **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
     - **Agent**: [agent or workflow that did the work]
     - **Task**: [one-sentence summary]
     - **Surprise**: [anything unexpected during the work]
    - **Proposal**: [pattern, gotcha, or guidance candidate to review, or "none"]
     - **Improvement**: [what would make the work smoother next time]
     - **Signal**: [context | instruction | workflow | failure | none]
     - **Constraint**: [proposed constraint, or "none"]

     Optional session metadata may be added when useful:

     - **Session metadata**:
       - Duration: [value or "unknown"]
       - Model tiers used: [value or "unknown"]
       - Pipeline stages completed: [value or "unknown"]
       - Agent delegation: [full | partial | manual | unknown]

     Signal types classify where the learning should route:
       context     -> HARNESS.md Context section
       instruction -> prompts, commands, or shared guidance
       workflow    -> local workflow guidance or human review
       failure     -> candidate constraint or missing check
       none        -> no routing needed

     -->
